content.short: Morpho improves yields and lowers borrowing costs by enhancing existing lending technology.
content.description: Morpho is a lending pool optimizer backed by a16z and Variant. It adds a peer-to-peer layer on top of established pools such as Compound and Aave, allowing suppliers and borrowers to access better effective rates while preserving the same liquidity and risk parameters. Morpho-Compound is an upgraded version of Compound, and Morpho-Aave is an upgraded version of Aave, delivering improved rate efficiency without changing the underlying pool structure or risk profile.
